result.reason: Neither level is fully satisfied because the cyber-insurance trigger does not expressly cover all processing of Customer Data. The redline is also non-minimal because it adds a one-year post-Term duration and expressly mandates product and contractual liability coverage beyond the stated positions. The original counterparts and language provisions remain effective, and no direct contradiction is introduced.
